question: What experiences do iPhone 11 buyers report when using SIM cards with different carriers?
answer:
One buyer reported that their AirTalk Wireless SIM card would not work in the iPhone 11, so they had to get an H2O (described as a knockoff AT&T) plan and SIM card instead. [e7e1ca1fb9f5_0]
Another buyer said the phone was reported stolen, so Apple's system would not allow it to be activated through a carrier. [e885dd2de642_0]
A buyer using a GSM SIM card reported being able to make calls, send texts, and use cellular data immediately after setup, and said the phone runs with IMEI and MEID so any SIM card carrier would have worked. [a8ab0d8232bf_1]
One buyer said the phone was advertised as working for T-Mobile but was actually carrier-locked to a different company and could not be unlocked through T-Mobile. [3ec97b2580fe_0]
A buyer advised checking the carrier lock setting under Settings, General, and About, where it should say no SIM restrictions, and noted that a SIM showing no service may need to be switched on by the carrier. [1ad0d79cdb48_0]
Other buyers reported that their SIM card worked perfectly right away, that the phone was not compatible with their carrier despite being described as unlocked, and that a phone ordered for T-Mobile was carrier-locked to Boost Mobile. [9ce12c3270ea_0] [c030c990391b_0] [f1b2abb0eb74_0]

chunks.text: Perfect cosmetically but buyer beware. This phone was suppose to be unlocked to any carrier. My airtalk wireless sims card would not work in it. I ended up have to get an H20 (knockoff AT&T) phone plan and sims card. Which mean I had to change my number and was a head ache all the way around. But it works fine now and seems to have decent battery life so that’s a plus.

BUY AT YOUR OWN RISK. When we received the phone everything was great. It was in perfect condition and we were very happy with it. The problems came when we inserted the sim card. It wouldn't work so we took it to our phone carrier and they let us know that the phone was reported stolen. We were sold a STOLEN phone. And because it was reported stolen apples system does not allow the phone to be activated through a phone career until the phone is retuned to the original owner. I contacted the seller and they never got back to us. I contacted customer service and still nothing. So the phone was not unlocked it was a stolen phone. Be careful.

As for the functionality of the phone, it works great. My sim card runs on GSM, so I needed an IMEI phone, and the description on amazon said it supported GSM sim card carriers, so that’s one of the reasons I made this purchase. I was able to make calls, texts, and use my cellular data immediately once I was done setting up the phone. As a side note, this phone actually runs with IMEI and MEID, so any sim card carrier would’ve worked with it, which comforting to know. The sound also works great. I was worried about this, especially, because I was reading the negative reviews, and they were saying the earbuds sound was hollow, but for me, it wasn’t that way.

Buyer Beware!. Ordered this phone because it said it worked for TMOBILE. It doesn't work with TMobile and it isn't unlocked. It is carrier locked to a different company and cannot be unlocked through TMobile. According to TMOBILE it can only be unlocked through the original carrier and they don't know who that is. Big waste of time and money! I've asked for a refund but this is just more days of waiting to be able to buy a phone. Writing this review so others can be cautious.

Recommend! Was in Mint condition. I had some thought and did some research buying a refurbished phone. The phone itself came in mint condition! No cracks or scratches. Works smoothly with no issues, good battery life. Just to verify! if you get an unlocked phone and have a hard time wonder why your SIM card is going through but says “no service”... before you get paranoid... (go to the settings... select general... Select about... then scroll till you see carrier lock... it should say (NO SIM RESTRICTIONS)... that’s how you know it’s unlocked to any carrier. If your SIM does go through but it read’s it with no service you have to go to your carrier and have them switch the SIM card on to your new phone from your old device. You’re welcome! I very recommend, do your research before purchasing. Enjoy your day

Watch out for this SCAM. They will sell the phones and then report it lost or stolen after purchase speaker on phone did not work make sure when you or if you purchase this you check the IMEI on your carrier provider and it will come up on the blacklist of phones that are reported lost or stolen very UPSET WITH THIS PURCHASE I GIVE A ZERO STAR THIS IS A SCAM I WAS SO EXCITED TO START USING THE PHONE TO FIND OUT THAT THE PRODUCTS WAS DAMAGED AND NOT SOLD PROPERLY OR CHECKED PROPERLY DO NOT SELL PHONES AND TELL THEM ITS UNLOCKED OR RENEWED AND THEY WON'T WORK

Works as it should.. It’s nice to buy something and use it right away. I put my Sim card in it, works perfectly. No having to call phone carriers to unlock codes just put your Sim card in it, set it up like a new phone would be set up.

Not compatible with all carriers. Description states phone is unlocked but you must make sure it’s compatible with your carrier. Mine was not and therefore useless to me and the SIM card I already have. Phone was in great condition though, wish it would have transferred.

Buyer beware. Buyer beware... be very careful buying these refurbished phones. I received mine which was supposed to be able to be used on T-Mobile's network. I took it into the store to link it to my plan and was informed that it could not be used because it is currently registered to another user. So it either was not wiped clean or was stolen. Returned and received a refund.

Sent phone for wrong carrier. Product received today on time, in the correct memory size and color, and in excellent shape. However, upon inserting the SIM card and trying to set it up, I learned that it is carrier-locked to Boost Mobile. I had ordered a phone compatible with T-Mobile. Hopefully Boost can unlock it tomorrow but now I have to wait another day when I should have just been able to swap in my existing SIM card and be ready to go. I would recommend ordering unlocked for nearly the same price, not worth the hassle trying to fix this.
